{{Quote|All right, baby girl, let's see what you've got.|Carasynthia Dune, hijacking a Trexler 906 Armored Marauder|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
The '''Trexler 906 Armored Marauder''', also known as '''Traxler Marauder 906''', was an [[armor]]ed box-shaped [[troop transport]] and a more combat-ready variant of the [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport]].<ref name="Trexler Marauder">{{Databank|trexler-marauder|Trexler Marauder}}</ref> By the [[New Republic Era]], the vehicle was valuable on the [[black market]], and at least one was used by the [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Imperial remnant]] led by [[Moff]] [[Gideon]]. One was present on Gideon's [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]] on [[Nevarro]], and was stolen by [[Greef Karga]], [[Carasynthia Dune]], and [[The Fledgling Mythrol|a Mythrol]] during a [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|skirmish]] at the facility.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Look. It's a mint Trexler Marauder. Do you know how much we can get for this on the black market?|The Mythrol, upon discovering a Trexler Marauder at the Nevarro Imperial base|<ref name="Chapter 12" />}}
[[File:Trexler906Engines-TMCh12.png|thumb|left|300px|The engines of a Trexler 906 Armored Marauder coming online.]]
The Trexler 906 Armored Marauder was a [[Color|grey]], box-like [[troop transport]] derived from the similar [[K79-S80 Imperial Troop Transport|K79-S80]] model.<ref name="Trexler Marauder" /><ref name="Chapter 12" /> It was extremely rare since so few were made by the Empire.<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> The vehicle was clad in metal plating resistant to standard [[blaster]] fire, thicker than the armor of the K79-S80, and provided space for three crew members consisting of two [[pilot]]s and one [[gunner]], as well as personnel to be transported.<ref name="Trexler Marauder" /> At the front, several blocky, open viewports for the drivers could be found on the flat nose of the craft, while at the rear, a power plant comprised of two thin, vertical outlets emitted a blue hue when activated to propel the vehicle. It levitated above the ground when traveling due to its [[repulsorlift]]s.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

Also located at the back was a dome-shaped dorsal twin [[laser turret]] operated by a gunner within the Marauder, whose position also contained viewports. This dorsal turret could target both ground-based units, such as [[speeder bike]]s, and units in the air, such as [[Starfighter|fighters]]. The gunner could also fire at individual personnel, even if they were on the Marauder itself.<ref name="Chapter 12" /> The targeting computer for the turret is similar to those on [[starship]]s, meaning a high likelihood of accuracy from its laser.<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> The targeting mechanism consisted of a screen where potential targets showed up as white objects on a red grid and black background. When a target was selected, its outline flashed red with an affirmative sequence of beeps. Additional beeping sounds informed the presence of nearby targets.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

[[File:The_Mandalorian_Chapter_12.png|thumb|right|270px|The position of the gunner for the dorsal twin laser turret.]]
The gunner had a rotating chair that they could swing around a whole revolution, allowing the turret to fire in any direction. It fired red [[laser]] bolts.<ref name="Chapter 12" /> The troop [[transport]]'s other weapons included two laser guns and four [[laser cannon]]s throughout the troop transport, some of which could be found at the two trapezoidal protrusions near the rear.<ref name="Chapter 12" /> Overall, the armament of the Marauder was considered to be more powerful than that of the K79-S80 transport.<ref name="Trexler Marauder" />

In the [[cockpit]], the drivers possessed various controls and buttons in red and white, some on a dashboard before them and others on the ceiling of the vehicle. Although one such Marauder was serviced by [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]], an individual who was not part of this [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] remnant could access the controls and activate the vehicle without much difficulty. A tarp could be thrown over the Trexler 906 Armored Marauder to protect it from degradation or unwanted attention.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==History==
[[File:Trexler906Flight-TMCh12.png|thumb|left|300px|Dune takes flight in the stolen Trexler 906 Armored Marauder.]]
During the [[New Republic Era]], at least one Trexler 906 Armored Marauder operated by Gideon's Imperial remnant was held at an [[Nevarro Imperial base|Imperial base]] on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]. When this base was [[Second skirmish on Nevarro|attacked]] by [[Magistrate]] [[Greef Karga]] and his allies, Karga, [[Carasynthia Dune]] and [[The Fledgling Mythrol|a Mythrol]] stole this Marauder from a platform of the facility to escape it. Dune was able to successfully activate the transport, with Karga in the gunner's seat, and sped it off the platform and into the gorge below the Imperial base. Despite being fired upon by several [[stormtrooper]]s, the vehicle was unaffected by these shots.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

[[File:Trexler906Chase-TMCh12.png|thumb|right|300px|The hijacked Marauder is chased by Imperial remnant forces.]]
A chase then ensued as several [[scout trooper]]s riding [[74-Z speeder bike]]s pursued the troop transport. Two of the bikes crashed into each other and exploded; Karga destroyed a third with the dual laser turret. Dune piloted the Marauder into another speeder bike, slamming it against the cliff face and destroying it. The last scout [[trooper]] managed to climb onto the top of the vehicle, holding an explosive, but Karga swung the turret around to face the front and shot the trooper to [[death]] at close range.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

Next, four [[Outland TIE fighter]]s chased the Marauder through the ravine. Karga again used the laser turret to severely damage the wing of the lead fighter, causing it to crash. However, the burning cockpit of the fighter slammed into the rear of the Marauder, incapacitating the turret as Karga abandoned that position. Once the troop transport had reached the open rock flats, the other three Outland fighters swooped overhead the craft, but were quickly dispatched by [[Din Djarin]] arriving in the ''[[Razor Crest]]''.<ref name="Chapter 12" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TrexlerConceptArt.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept art of the Marauder chase for "Chapter 12: The Siege" of ''The Mandalorian'' television series.]]
In concept art for "[[Chapter 12: The Siege]]," the fourth episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television show ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', the chase of the Trexler 906 Armored Marauder depicts the vehicle with three passenger or cargo compartments on the outside, causing it to seem like a K79-S80 troop transport. However, the forward section of the craft largely retains its appearance.<ref name="Chapter 12" />
